legend: On vacations n pupils decided to go on excursion and gather all together. They need to overcome the path with the length l meters. Each of the pupils will go with the speed equal to v1. To get to the excursion quickly, it was decided to rent a bus, which has seats for k people (it means that it can't fit more than k people at the same time) and the speed equal to v2. In order to avoid seasick, each of the pupils want to get into the bus no more than once.

Determine the minimum time required for all n pupils to reach the place of excursion. Consider that the embarkation and disembarkation of passengers, as well as the reversal of the bus, take place immediately and this time can be neglected.
input: The first line of the input contains five positive integers n, l, v1, v2 and k (1 ≤ n ≤ 10 000, 1 ≤ l ≤ 109, 1 ≤ v1 < v2 ≤ 109, 1 ≤ k ≤ n) — the number of pupils, the distance from meeting to the place of excursion, the speed of each pupil, the speed of bus and the number of seats in the bus.
output: Print the real number — the minimum time in which all pupils can reach the place of excursion. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error won't exceed 10 - 6.
note: In the first sample we should immediately put all five pupils to the bus. The speed of the bus equals 2 and the distance is equal to 10, so the pupils will reach the place of excursion in time 10 / 2 = 5.

legend.ai: 假期里，n 名学生决定去郊游并集合在一起。他们需要走完长度为 l 米的路程。每名学生的速度均为 v1。为了尽快到达郊游地点，决定租一辆公交车，公交车可搭载 k 人（即同一时刻不能搭载超过 k 人），速度为 v2。为了避免晕车，每名学生都希望最多上车一次。
请确定所有 n 名学生到达郊游地点所需的最短时间。认为乘客的上车、下车以及公交车掉头都能立即完成，所需时间可以忽略不计。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含五个正整数 n、l、v1、v2 和 k（1 ≤ n ≤ 10 000，1 ≤ l ≤ 10^9，1 ≤ v1 < v2 ≤ 10^9，1 ≤ k ≤ n），分别表示学生人数、从集合点到郊游地点的距离、每名学生的速度、公交车的速度以及公交车的座位数。

output.ai: 输出一个实数——所有学生到达郊游地点所需的最短时间。若答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10^-6，则视为正确。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，我们应立即将五名学生全部安排上车。公交车的速度为 2，距离为 10，因此学生将在 10 / 2 = 5 的时间内到达郊游地点。
